exposure: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Crohn's Disease and Ulcerative Colitis)
Inflammatory Bowel Disease type (Crohn's Disease and Ulcerative Colitis)
cohort: Nine pregnant women with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (7 with Ulcerative Colitis and 2 with Crohn's Disease).
finding: In this small case series, the authors report successful pregnancy outcomes in women with IBD treated with low dose LMWH and LDC, suggesting that this treatment may maintain better pregnancy outcomes without exacerbation of IBD.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at birth was 36 weeks and 6 days.
